core_obligations: Part (1): work locally so K has a strictly perfect presentation E^* -> K with cohomology isos in degrees > m and a surjection in degree m; induct on the top degree n: if n = m then H^m is a quotient of E^n; if n > m then E^{n-1} -> E^n is surjective and locally split (local-lift-map), write E^{n-1} = E'  oplus  E^n and reduce to the shorter complex; conclude H^m(K) is of finite type (proof lines 12234-12251).
Part (2): as in (1) reduce to E^i = 0 for i > m+1; then H^{m+1}(K) =~ H^{m+1}(E^*) = Coker(E^m -> E^{m+1}) is of finite presentation (proof lines 12252-12262).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to a strictly perfect presentation.
Induct downward on the top degree.
Read off the finite presentation for part (2).
difficulty_reason: Both parts work locally on a strictly perfect presentation; part (1) inducts on the top degree, splitting off E^n through a locally split surjection, and part (2) reads H^{m+1} off the truncated presentation as a cokernel of strictly perfect modules.
